reviews.text: Was good to get peace of mind, vet was lovely BUT even though I was asked if any vomiting - and I said none  - was given an anti sickness jab and charged £31 for it ? No need for this but yet again just something else to charge me for ! £51 for consultation and £16 for anul gland  - which was empty - nothing done  ? But charged for that.
Very lovely first experience with our 6 weeks kittens. The team is very responsive, kind, and professional. We felt very re-assured and the little ones were very looked after.
So happy with them! Everyone is very lovely and professional, Princess Tallulah is in the best hands!
Hi, Claudia. Thank you so much for rating your experience with us so highly!
Fantastic experience. Really welcoming and friendly staff and my pet was seen to in good time.

First visit to this small surgery with my not too happy cat and me much the same ..Was welcomed by a lovely smiling receptionist into a cosy almost cottage type clean waiting room.She could not do enough to make us both feel welcomed and stress free.Loved the atmosphere and my cat caught on to the vibe.Vet greated us with a welcoming smile so easy to talk too and she checked my cat over and he was as good as gold during this usually a big ball of furious fur struggling to  escape and takes a vet and a nurse to deal with him. Received medication for him and was instructed clearly how to use it.Recommend this surgery it's also therapy for stressed out pet owners.Will use again.Thank you all @ number 1.
Hi, Mauricio. We are delighted that you had a great experience with us. Thank you for taking the time to rate us!
I have only just moved to this practice but so far my experience has been really good, informed and friendly.

I found Parish Lane Veterinary Surgery a very professional, pleasant and clean place to bring your pets and have them treated.
The Vet, she was very professional and patience with my pet. She took great care of the pet's needs while she administered the booster vaccine.
The receptionist was most polite and cheerful. She asked appropriate questions regarding my pet if I wanted help, any support or any other issues, very kind.
Thank you for the fridge magnet.

Vey warm. Lovely staff. Genuinely care and very clear with treatment plan. We just had our first visit as we were not happy with paxton vets and we will be happily staying.
Thankyou

I took my two cats for a check up and Dr Rami was lovely. He obviously loves cats and kept talking to them as much as me. I was very happy with the service and advice from him and the receptionist.

Outstanding surgery who could see me and my dog on short notice. Parish Lane was recommended to me by someone I met on the tube, and I'm grateful for his recommendation. Dr. Rami was so friendly to me and to my dog, who he examined thoroughly, and Vanessa and Val (I believe their names were) also so kind and welcoming when I arrived.
Very efficient. Very kind. Confident examination and sound advice. Not pushy with sales. Good value.
Fabulous receptionist and all staff great with my nervous cat.

We are always greeted in a friendly manner and the staff are very polite and helpful

We've got 2 kittens, 3 months old and went back to Parish Lane vets for the first time since our old cat died 6 years ago. While the vet has changed the service is still great and I have been really impressed on both visits so far for their initial vaccines etc.

Not my closest vets but have visited on more than one occasion when we’ve needed to. They are consistently understanding, welcoming and I find the advice and support are top notch. Val on reception is a gem!
Brilliant vets 10/10

Always lovely and helpful

Very good service from one of the best veterinary surgeries in SE London. Remi (not sure if i've spelt his name correctly) is an excellent vet - clear communication, good explanations,, not rushed, great 'bedside manner', clearly has the animals welfare at heart.
Very gentle vet, obviously loves animals, sensible suggestions on keeping cat healthy
Hi, Linda. We appreciate the rating, and are glad we could provide you with a positive experience!

I've been taking my dogs to this vets for years and they're without question the best I've ever seen. The vet who looked after one of my dogs in his final months is one of the most compassionate, kind and caring people I've had the privileged to meet. This isn't just a business for them, they genuinely care about every animal they care for & the kindness and compassion they showed me when my dog finally passed away was incredible. On top of all of that they never overcharge and always do whats best. They're a credit to the community and should be recognised for it <3

So grateful that we were fitted in on the end of surgery after our elderly cat became very “wobbly” after breakfast. The vet was so kind and administered a painkilling injection for what is probably arthritis. A kind welcome for Klaus always awaits here. Many thanks.

Always have a great experience at this lovely vets. Always welcoming. Love the receptionists! They feel like old friends by now. They are all really good at calming our very lively dogs! Great treats slways available.
Brilliant service, all very helpful.
The care taken, we couldn't ask for more!

My experience with Parish Lane Vets was very poor. I was charged over £50 for standard human eye drops worth about £6, with no explanation at the time of purchase.

When I queried it and asked for a breakdown, I waited weeks for a response and still didn’t receive a clear justification. The lack of transparency and poor handling of my complaint is unacceptable.
Excellent and very friendly service always.

Everyone at this practice has been consistently lovely to my cat and I.

I recently adopted a former stray, who's needed several visits in a short space of time. Everyone I've come into contact with has been kind, patient and genuinely caring throughout.

Parish Lane have provided wonderful care for my beloved aging doggie, improving the quality of his life immeasurably, with their expertise. Kind, compassionate and efficient, I highly recommend them. 🙏🏼🐶🐾 …

Today we visited the vet with our new puppy!
Abbie was so warm & welcoming, she greeted our pup by name ♥️. Vanessa who was equally as lovely & sweet & helped with paperwork. We met the vet Rami who fell in love with him… he gave great advice and answered all questions we had. He was vaccinated & chipped and got free toys & treats…. Definitely recommend. Thank you ALL!!!!

We recently registered with Parish Lane Vets and can't recommend them enough. We have been twice now for our dog's vaccinations, and both times have been a real pleasure. The staff are so warm and friendly - from the moment I called to make an appointment, the receptionist made me feel at ease. We met a different receptionist on each visit, and both times we were made to feel so welcome. The vet we saw was lovely too - she was calm and relaxed, and made the experience really positive for our dog. So positive in fact, that now every time we walk past the surgery, she makes a beeline for the front door! We really appreciate the effort and care the staff put in to each visit - thanks so much Parish Lane!

My cats Pablo and Queen attended Parish Lane Vet surgery for their annual vaccinations. Staff were friendly and accommodating. The vets I’ve seen were both very warm and kind, and made a lovely fuss of the felines which made them feel very special. Very good experience.

Amazing would recommend Parish Vets to anyone. Very helpful and very caring. Lovely people the first vets I have ever been to that shows so much compassion in a work place.my cats Mimi and Daisy was very happy and wasn't stressed very clean no smell of animals a amazing place. If I was a animal in the next life that's the place I'd love my owner to take me.

Awesome experience from front desk to the vet. Vet was extremely clear when checking and explaining what he was checking for my dog. Very kind to my dog to make him feel safe. Gave me awesome info to plan ahead and what I need to do for my dog in the year.

Great vet. Made a short notice appointment and was seen to within the hour. Our vet was Rami who was Professional, friendly, knowledgeable and provided excellent care. I felt my dog was in safe hands. Highly recommend.

We do not visit the vets often, but called up after our cat got in a scrap and wasn't eating. I was relieved to speak to someone who cared, and grateful to get a same day appointment. The receptionist was so lovely and made us all feel relaxed and looked after. We were seen on time by the vet, who treated our cat with care. He checked him over and talked us through treatment options, and made sure we were happy with how to administer the medicine. We booked a follow up appointment to check progress. We left feeling happy with the visit, and confident our cat would be ok. We would recommend this vets practice to a friend.

Vet services are going through quite an interesting time at the moment with accusations of price fixing, high costs, lack of transparency and concentrated local markets due to corporate ownerships reducing competition. Other issues include concerns about over-treatment, insufficient information for owners to make informed choices, and an inadequate complaints and redress system. That is not the case at Parish Lane. The attention our dog received was meticulous and caring and the pricing was very easy to understand.
Great vets who took care of Basil in his puppy days. Really caring, friendly staff who helped to put him at ease - would thoroughly recommend.

Thank you to Parish Lane Vets for being so welcoming to our new puppy. We called ahead to ask a couple of questions which they happily answered. I came here a few months ago after a bad experience at a previous vets - where my dog was going through a prolonged diagnosis and I was passed from pillar to post. So it gave me a lot of comfort as soon as my dog was seen by Rami. He was very thorough, showed so much care and empathy and really took the time to talk me through all options and ensure I understood everything. We’ve now seen him several times and each time has been the same positive experience. It makes such a difference to be able to return to the same vet, and build a relationship where they understand your dog’s history and needs. Would highly recommend if you want a vet who is knowledgeable, caring and who actually likes dogs. And hats off to Vanessa on reception too, who always provides a warm welcome. The waiting area could do with some TLC and a lick of paint - but you can’t have everything :-)
